title: Butt-weld valve with no face-to-face length -> merged weld, reported not silent
rule: بدون ابعاد face-to-face، شیر بدنه ندارد و دو جوشش روی یک نقطه ادغام می‌شود — موتور باید این را گزارش کند نه اینکه بی‌صدا کم‌شماری کند
note: This locks the degraded path. The register is knowingly one weld short here; what must never regress is the warning that says so. Fixing it is a data problem — read the dimension off the drawing — not an engine problem.
